strategy.scope: robot-oriented scene triage followed by open-vocabulary concept segmentation; first-pass recall must be audited
strategy.model_residency: Qwen scene guidance then release; SAM3 text guidance then release; Qwen candidate reasoning then release
strategy.qwen_call_policy: one scene-guidance call per configured source-image batch, then one detailed call per source image containing every retained candidate and every active memory object card
strategy.scene_guidance_memory_context: none; discovery is driven only by each new scene view
strategy.qwen_error_policy: one model call per logical scope; persist the raw result and fail the affected scope without automatic retry, single-source rescue, normalization, or fallback
strategy.sam_candidate_semantics: SAM3 detections already above the processor text-confidence threshold, followed by script area, duplicate, same-prompt containment, and fair per-prompt capacity filtering
strategy.object_card_selection: all active cards with configured recent reference views; no script-side similarity ranking or shortlist
strategy.uncertain_policy: persist pending; do not immediately repeat
